scenarios.title: Ask independent decisions in one round
scenarios.prompt: Use grill-me to sharpen my workshop plan. We must decide the audience and online versus in-person delivery. Room size matters only if we choose in-person.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: May ask every question in one list or serialize independent questions unnecessarily.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Load grilling; ask audience and delivery together with numbered recommendations, defer room size until its prerequisite is settled, and wait for the user answers.

scenarios.title: Keep the interview before action
scenarios.prompt: Use grill-me on my migration plan. I have answered the current round, but two design decisions remain unresolved. Please keep questioning until we share the full plan.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: May summarize the current answers as a complete plan and start implementation.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Continue recomputing the decision frontier, surface unresolved branches, and retain the original user-confirmed shared-understanding boundary before action.
